description: Synthetic FHIR-JSON referrals feed (batch bundle): 2 coded ServiceRequest resources (sr-1 SNOMED-coded referencing an Organization performer, sr-2 CPT-coded with no performer) each identity-anchored via the seam + 1 malformed ServiceRequest missing the service coding (quarantine). No member or provider names; subjects are source ids anchored through the identity seam and performers are raw references only (real NPI/NPPES resolution is deferred to I8A).
